about.whoWeAreBody: {{appName}} is a modern radio station bringing you live broadcasts, curated podcasts, breaking news, and a direct line to the presenters and programs you love — all in one app. Whether you're tuning into the live stream, catching up on a podcast episode offline, or requesting your favorite song, we're here to keep you connected to the sound of your community, anywhere you go.
about.missionBody: To inform, entertain, and connect our listeners through compelling live radio, original podcasts, and timely news — delivered with the quality and reliability a modern audience expects, on whatever device they choose.
